summary: Mapped the wall: apply copies only the app root, and Vite resolves a tsconfig's `extends` relative to that file, so your-spotify's `extends: ../tsconfig.json` pointed above the lane. Fixed generally in lane.ts: extends chains reaching outside the app root are flattened into a self-contained lane tsconfig.json emitted as a third composed lane file; unreadable chains are named as unhandled, not rewritten. 9 tests added, two running real Vite 8.0.16 (one reproduces the wall, one builds green). Flame held 9/9 count 0, shape unmoved. your-spotify PROVEN 9/9, count 0 — proven 13 to 14. Trust regenerated, census unmoved at 200, all guards hold. Blocked on one pinned integer outside the contract.
open_questions: your-spotify becoming proven adds a corpus-conformance vertical, moving sourceApplications 15 to 16. Two tests pin that integer. I moved the in-contract one (packages/cli/test/corpus-conformance.test.ts). The other, packages/trust/test/trust-package.test.ts:995 `sourceApplications: 15`, is outside my file contract and is the sole failing assertion in `pnpm exec vp test --project node` (1 failed, 2852 passed). May I have packages/trust/test/** to change that one integer to 16, or should a follow-up unit own it?
